what: Two words (or two lines) are tied to scroll and pushed in opposite directions — the left one to the left, the right one to the right. In “gather” mode they converge from outside toward the center · in “stagger” mode the two lines start half a screen width outside, and after the board enters the screen they come toward each other by the scrolled amount (.8px per 1px, .2px on phones) and pass each other

options.dist: Push distance — px number or ‹60vw›, default 75 (one third on phones) · for cross it is the start distance, default 50vw
options.mode: With gather, they gather from outside · with cross, they start outside and come toward each other in direct proportion to scroll and pass one another (no end)
options.rate: cross — px moved per 1px of scroll, default .8
options.rate-narrow: cross — at narrow width or below, default .2
options.narrow: cross — width (px) that splits rate, default 1024

from.where: index.js .movie__logo--1 (from the left) · --2 (from the right) two wordmark lines — mode: cross(50vw · .8 · phone .2), original #slideLogo1 · #slideLogo2
